info.title: SimForge Cloud API
info.description: The public SimForge API: what `simforge --cloud`, `simforge login` and the Python client call. Authenticate with a bearer token: the access token `simforge login` stores, an AI agent's access token (its recipe is `/auth.md`), or an `sfk_` API key. A `/api/v1` 401 carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="<host>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"`. `/api/v1` errors are an `ErrorEnvelope`; `/api/cli` and `/agent` errors are an OAuth error object.

RenderRigTransform.description: Actor-local metres: +X forward, +Y up, +Z left. Rotation yaw (+Y, CCW), then pitch (+Z), then roll (+X).

modality.description: The native engine renders rgb; the other camera modalities are refused (native_modality_unsupported).

mountFrame.description: What the mount rotation composes with: the host body (default) or the host's sampled world-stabilized gimbal attitude (a drone flight's `gimbal` channel); the mount translation stays body-relative. Lidar and radar ride the body.

cameraModel.description: F-theta lens (pixel-distance-to-angle polynomial). Rendered as pinhole sub-views warped per pixel; the polynomial must rise monotonically to the output corners, which must stay below 90 deg.

referenceResolution.description: Calibration image size; the output must keep its aspect (within 1 %) and is a centre-aligned resize of it.

principalPoint.description: Reference pixels; integer values are pixel centres.

pixeldistToAnglePoly.description: theta(r) = sum c_i r^i: r in reference pixels from the principal point, theta in radians from the optical axis.

angleToPixeldistPoly.description: The calibration's forward fit (rad -> reference px). Informational: carried for consumers that project points; the renderer uses pixeldistToAnglePoly.

linearCde.description: Linear skew [c, d, e]: pixel = principalPoint + [[c, d], [e, 1]] x polynomial offset.

maxAngleRad.description: The calibration's valid half-angle; informational (pixels beyond it are rendered).

lowerFovDeg.description: The native service's fan is symmetric: lowerFovDeg must equal -upperFovDeg.

RenderRig.title: simforge.render-rig/v1
RenderRig.description: The sensor rig `simforge render --rig` renders. `sources` and `sensorHosts` are the hosted render intent's `renderSpec.sources` (RenderSourceV3) and `sensorHosts`, field for field, so a rig copied from a hosted render request renders unchanged. Without `sensorHosts` every source is hosted by its own actorId (the host's vehicle asset is its timeline catalog id); without `clip` the whole timeline is rendered. Both are reported in results.json.

video.description: The native engine encodes mp4 + h264 (libx264 CRF 18); fps also sets the radar sample schedule.

RenderRunInput.description: The input of a `render` run: a scenario of the workspace (at a revision) rendered by the 2D or the 3D engine, through a sensor rig.

revisionId.description: An immutable revision of it. Default: the scenario's current revision.

engine.description: `2d`: the top-down map video (CPU). `3d`: the Helios Engine (GPU); the schematic look is `3d` with `preset: schematic`.

preset.description: `training`, `showcase` or `schematic` (3D only). Default for a hosted 3D render: `training`.

rig.description: A complete simforge.render-rig/v1 rig, or {clip} for 2D only. Clip endSeconds must exceed startSeconds. Default: the built-in front camera on the scenario's ego.

outputs.description: `video` (default): one MP4 per sensor. `stills`: the RGB frames as PNGs (a preview).

post.description: The token endpoint (RFC 6749). The public `simforge-cli` client (its `client_id` required): the device code grant, `authorization_code` with PKCE, and rotating `refresh_token`. An AI agent (auth.md, no `client_id`): the claim grant `urn:workos:agent-auth:grant-type:claim`, polling its registration, and the JWT-bearer grant (RFC 7523) re-exchanging the identity assertion the claim grant returned; agents get no refresh token. Unauthenticated by design: each grant is bound by a device code, PKCE, a claim token, an assertion this host signed, or an unspent refresh token. While the person has not approved yet, the device and claim grants answer `authorization_pending` (or `slow_down`).

200.description: A CLI session's access and refresh tokens; an agent's first access token and identity assertion (claim grant); or a fresh access token (JWT-bearer grant).

post.description: auth.md Step 3. `service_auth`: an AI agent registers for the account `login_hint` names; show the person `claim.verification_uri` and `claim.user_code` (only that account, signed in with a verified email, can approve it), then poll the token endpoint with the claim grant. `identity_assertion`: an ID-JAG from a trusted agent provider (`issuer_not_enabled` while none is); it never creates or verifies an account. The first ID-JAG of a provider subject answers `401 interaction_required` with a claim ceremony; once the person confirmed the link, an ID-JAG answers an identity assertion valid for at most an hour. `401 login_required` when `auth_time` is missing or over an hour old. Refusals carry `detail.reason`. `anonymous` answers `anonymous_not_enabled`. 10 registrations per address per minute; 30 ID-JAGs per provider subject per 10 minutes.

200.description: A `service_auth` registration and its first user code, or an identity assertion for a linked provider subject.

post.description: auth.md `events_endpoint` (present while an agent provider is trusted): the provider pushes a Security Event Token (RFC 8417, RFC 8935 push delivery), signed by its pinned JWKS with this issuer as `aud`. The identity-assertion revoked event revokes every session of its (provider, subject): their access tokens and identity assertions. Errors are `{err, description}` (RFC 8935 section 2.4).

get.description: Check Cloud API availability
System status for any signed-in caller: component health, worker counts per class, queue depths and incidents. Counts only, the same for every caller, refreshed at most every 20 seconds.

parameters.description: An ISO date or date-time (default 30 days ago).

parameters.description: Runs created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

post.description: Start a run; dryRun returns costEstimateCents, costBreakdown and cancellation terms without starting work. Paid submissions require maxCostCents and an Idempotency-Key header (400 max_cost_required or idempotency_key_required). Admission atomically checks account free-2D quotas, max_active_jobs, daily spending and credit holds before queuing work. Over-budget work returns 402 budget_exceeded; insufficient credits return 402 insufficient_credits; unserved work returns 403 cloud_not_open. Reusing the same key and request returns the original run without reserving again.

200.description: Quote or idempotent replay, including managed Alpamayo evaluations.

201.description: Created run or canonical managed evaluation.

402.description: `insufficient_credits`: the workspace's credits do not cover the estimate (`detail.requestedCents`, `detail.balanceCents`, `detail.creditsUrl`, `detail.checkout`); or `budget_exceeded` (`detail.limit` `max_cost` or `daily_cap`).

403.description: `cloud_not_open`: SimForge Cloud is off here, or no worker here runs the work yet (the reason names it, `detail.code` `run_kind_unavailable`, `detail.kinds` its job kinds); or `insufficient_scope`.

post.description: Score a succeeded 3D scenario render with pinned Alpamayo 1.5 BF16. Requires maxCostCents and Idempotency-Key, including dryRun. One canonical compute job; no GPU work or writes for dryRun.
